description: Create a device share invitation that allows an external user to access a specific device in your tailnet.

allowExitNode.description: Whether the invited device can be used as an exit node (default: false)

deviceId.description: The device ID to create an invite for. nodeId from tailscale_list_devices (e.g. nPM2KNuedB21DEVEL); numeric id ok; not the nodeKey.

email.description: Email address to send the invite to

multiUse.description: Whether the invite can be used more than once (default: false)

name: tailscale_create_device_invite
title: Create device invite
